belief_statement: Preliminary evidence indicates that body into natural tapping may influence beauty becomes body instrument. The evidence base (2 findings, 2 studies) is growing but not yet conclusive.

latent_variables.name: Cultural background
latent_variables.rationale: Individual/cultural differences theory is implicated. Cultural norms around nature, noise, or space may moderate effects.

latent_variables.name: Mechanism selection
latent_variables.rationale: Multiple mechanisms are implicated (Individual/Cultural Differences, Psychophysics / Perception, Design Principles). A latent variable may determine which pathway is activated.

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of body into natural tapping, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of body into natural tapping on beauty becomes body instrument replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is moderate. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: Which mechanism best explains body into natural tapping → beauty becomes body instrument?
research_needs.rationale: 3 candidate mechanisms exist. Process tracing would identify the active pathway.

research_needs.question: What is the dose-response curve for body into natural tapping effects on beauty becomes body instrument?
research_needs.rationale: Dose-response data enables design guidelines with specific thresholds.
